title: Chapter 238
text:
At night, Han Xiao heard that a transport team had transported a large amount of ammunition and firearms from a warehouse closer to the headquarters. They would return in twenty minutes.

Han Xiao locked onto a transport truck driver, changed his face, and lured him out. When he was alone, he twisted the driver's neck, then changed his face and clothes. Dealing with the body was a troublesome matter, so Han Xiao chose a method that did not cause bloodshed, and there was no smell of blood. His method was very interesting. He directly found the players, used the quota to assign a mission, and threw the body to the players in the base to deal with. The mission name was unknown, but the players did not care about that. As soon as they saw the mission reward, they immediately accepted the mission to help.

"Convenient." Han Xiao sighed. He had a new idea. The players should be able to help him infiltrate.

Even if the Germinal Organization's relationship with the players was fixed, they still retained the freedom to accept missions. They were potential allies, and the Germinal Organization did not know this.

Disguised as a driver, he quickly received the order. The GPS in the car showed the route, and Han Xiao followed the convoy. Half a day later, they arrived at the warehouse. Han Xiao continued to use this method to obtain new information.

In two days, Han Xiao, who had changed his identity many times, finally arrived at a position close to the headquarters.

Beyond the barbed wire, he could see a group of dark bases in the distance. The atmosphere was strict, the scale was huge, and the area was not smaller than a medium-sized city. This was the headquarters of the Germinal Organization. Han Xiao knew that the real core area was hidden underground.

Han Xiao asked the soldiers stationed here for information. It was almost impossible to enter the underground headquarters through conventional means, so he had to find someone with a special identity.

…

Fang Yu slowly woke up and found himself lying on a hospital bed in a medical tent. Beside him were wounded soldiers. Seeing that he had woken up, the doctor walked over and said, "I've treated your wounds. You were unconscious for a day."

"How's Miga Town?"

"The reinforcements were in time. The enemy was defeated, and some people escaped. We're calculating the losses."

"Let me see …" Fang Yun coughed a few times weakly. The doctor hurriedly picked up the bottle to feed him. Fang Yun grabbed it, raised his head and drank a big mouthful of water, gasping for breath.

As a Super, his treatment was naturally not bad. Very soon, someone brought over the battle damage statistics. Fang Yun could not wait to look at it. Seeing that all his teammates were confirmed dead, he could not help but feel sad and angry. He flipped to the enemy's death statistics, and suddenly, his eyes narrowed.

"One less enemy." Fang Yu realized that the one missing was Kareth. His superiors quickly sent him the information of the enemy. This was a video of the battle. By taking a screenshot of the enemy's appearance and comparing it to the database, the identity of the enemy was confirmed. Basically, all the Supers in the Germinal Organization were in the database.

"That's him. The young one is called Kareth. I saw him die with my own eyes."

The officer frowned. "But according to our eyewitness report, Kareth escaped and is alive and well. We didn't find Kareth's body."

A chill rose from Fang Yun's heart. He immediately thought of that "refugee".

…

In the underground headquarters of the Germinal Organization, the leader was looking at the tactical map in silence.

There were red and blue areas on the map. The red areas were the Six Nations' troops, and the blue areas were the organization's forces. The red areas surrounded the blue areas, and the blue areas were constantly being compressed. This was the situation of the Germinal Organization. However, the leader did not care about these gains and losses. He did not put all his combat power into the main battlefield. Instead, he secretly prepared a counterattack, but he had not carried it out yet. This was because there was a prerequisite, and that was to first get rid of Zero, who could 'foresee'. Otherwise, there would be no point in exposing the plan.

Although Destiny's Child had predicted that Zero would walk right into the trap, the details needed to be fixed by the leader. He deliberately left some gaps in the deployment of the main battlefield. If Zero wanted to invade the headquarters, he would most likely take these routes. However, the news sent back by the hidden spies in the dark disappointed the leader time and time again. There was no one who could sneak in through those gaps.

Han Xiao's method of sneaking in indirectly avoided the leader's spies.

The longer this dragged on, the more anxious the leader became. The 'foresight' of Zero was like the Sword of Damocles hanging over the head of the organization, hindering their actions.

"Not here yet …" The leader asked the spies as usual, but the result was still disappointing. He could not help but start to doubt whether Destiny's Child's prediction this time was a failure.

This was because he really did not understand why Zero would come to the headquarters. He could not figure out what Han Xiao's goal was.

He would never have thought that Han Xiao's goal would be Aurora. There was no warning at all.

…

The industrial waste and the thick dark clouds dyed the sky gray. The thick clouds looked like they were going to fall at any moment, occupying the sky within dozens of miles. The faint rumbling of thunder rolled in the clouds, but the lightning was imprisoned in the dark clouds and could not penetrate. Just looking up made the Germinal soldiers feel depressed.

The ground headquarters was a group of majestic bases. Vehicles came and went, and sentries guarded every intersection to check all kinds of documents. The central base was a huge steel fortress. The ferocious metal tower pierced straight into the sky, like a miniature version of the gray-black mountain range.

The entrance was a huge alloy door. The side doors on both sides were personnel passageways, and the middle was a passageway for vehicles. It was spacious enough for three tanks to go in and out side by side. The outer walls of the fortress were also built with landing platforms. From time to time, helicopters would take off and land.

The entrance was very busy. The troops went in and out. Rows of guards stood by the roadside, patrolling the surroundings to ensure safety.

One of the guards was Han Xiao in disguise. His eyes darted around, observing the surroundings.

The effect of the Optical Simulator Mask was outstanding. This kind of infiltration method was unpredictable. After many operations, he finally obtained an identity that allowed him to enter the headquarters. In order to become a guard, Han Xiao patiently waited for a few days. There was no need to mention where the original owner of this identity went. When necessary, Han Xiao would not be soft-hearted.

When it was time to change shifts, Han Xiao followed the troops into the ground headquarters. The space was spacious. The first floor was more than ten meters high. After entering the door, there was a spacious space. Vehicles were loading and unloading goods, and officers were making arrangements here. It was noisy, engines were rumbling, and smoke filled the air. The air quality was very bad, and the PM2.5 index was probably off the charts.

The west side was the garage door, and a large number of ground vehicles were parked inside. The other directions were personnel passageways.

Han Xiao knew the basic structure of the Germinal Organization's headquarters. The ground headquarters were connected to the underground headquarters. In the elevator, through identification with the identity card, people would be brought to the underground headquarters. There were many people with authority in the ground headquarters. Even some of the players who passed by had authority (faction relationship). Han Xiao secretly locked onto a suitable target. In a secret corner, he changed the identity of the target and entered the elevator with the new identity card. He swiped it on the identification device, and the green light lit up. Then, the elevator stopped at the ground floor. After opening, there was a metal passageway that led to the underground headquarters.

After opening the door and walking in, the underground headquarters was solemn and quiet. The corridors were winding, and it was not as busy as the ground. The air was filled with a solemn atmosphere. The members walking in and out were expressionless, and their footsteps were hurried. It seemed that everyone was very busy. Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He hid the energy in his body and pretended to be an ordinary person. He straightened his collar and walked in quietly. In his mind, he was planning his next move.

Coming to the underground headquarters was half the battle won!

Sigh, this is called infiltration. Master Kang can finally rest in peace.

If he delayed for too long, it would not be good for him. If his identity was exposed, he would immediately be in a situation similar to the Unparalleled Creed series. Han Xiao touched his equipment bag and felt slightly relieved.

He had to go through the backend of the mainframe to shut down the defense measures in order to save people in the headquarters. Furthermore, his other target also needed to be in contact with the mainframe, so he needed someone with authority to control the mainframe as a hostage. Han Xiao had already locked onto someone with enough authority.
